messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-runtime: kv_cache memory anomaly on cluster hosted-eu-2. Multiple OOMs detected, 503s observed. Pager routed to sasha-oncall. :rotating_light:

sasha-oncall: acked. spinning up triage. saw spike at ~4898765400, hosts going from 20%->95% KV usage.

mike-runtime: joining — seeing continuous-batching v2 roll (rolled at 02:10 UTC) likely in path. metrics: kvmap entries per-session jumped 12x for some long prompts.

tanvi-sre: copied logs to /var/log/hosted/kv/4898765432.log and pinned heap diffs. eviction rate dropped while insert rate surged. looks like prefetch + longer prompts -> eviction backlog -> OOM.

elaine-support: any customer impact known? Support queue filling up with timeouts from chat API. Customer X (acct-redwood-42) reporting errors.

jason-eng: noted. initial thought: continuous batching config increased max_batch_window_ms to 120 from 20 in the roll, which lets sessions accumulate large KV footprints before flush/evict. that plus aggressive prefetch created runaway per-session kvmap.

sasha-oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert batch_window to 20ms, 2) disable kv prefetch on hosted runtime, 3) apply emergency session_kv_cap = 256k tokens. doing steps in that order.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by sasha-oncall: revert continuous-batching v2 -> v1 on hosted-eu-2. Deploy id: dpl-7890. Started at 02:18 UTC.

mike-runtime: applying kv prefetch disable (global flag) now: `redwoodctl set config hosted --key=kv.prefetch.enabled --value=false`

ops-bot: config change applied on 24 hosts in hosted-eu-2 (success:24/24).

tanvi-sre: lowering max_batch_window_ms to 20 across pool via runtime toggle. patch id: rb-2026.

jason-eng: session_kv_cap applied as emergency: `redwoodctl set config hosted --key=session.kv_cap_tokens --value=256000` — enforcement at runtime boundary.

elaine-support: seeing immediate drop in new 503s. backlog of retries still causing some client timeouts but trending down. Customers notified via internal slack support-warn channel.

sasha-oncall: handoff to eng-runtime for post-deploy validation. tagging @mike-runtime and @jason-eng. I'll keep paging open for 30m then transition. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike-runtime: running smoke: generate/stream tests across 50 sessions with long prompts — no memory growth beyond baseline. eviction rate normalized.

jason-eng: root cause hypothesis: batch_window increase let long-prompt sessions accumulate KV entries from prefetch and inflight sequences; prefetch eagerly loaded future KV; combined with a regression in kvmap compaction in v2 leads to insert-only behavior until OOM.

elaine-support: drafting customer note for affected tenants: short blurb saying: we observed memory-related errors due to a runtime config change; mitigation applied; no data loss; we will follow up with timeline and root cause.

tanvi-sre: collecting host-level traces and producing temporary flamegraphs. saving diffs to s3://redwood-incidents/4898765432/traces.tar.gz

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager escalation suppressed by sasha-oncall at 02:35 UTC (manual) — incident still open.

sasha-oncall: status update: mitigations complete, traffic healthy, latency back to SLO. moving to recovery phase. leaving a follow-up action list:
- revert continuous-batching v2 roll across remaining regions until root cause fixed
- write hotpatch to make prefetch rate-limited for long sessions
- add per-session kvmap eviction heuristic and instrument count thresholds
- contact top impacted customers with RCA draft

jason-eng: creating a sandbox repro harness to test large prompt + prefetch interplay. will post PR for compaction fix (prefetch-safe) by EOD.

mike-runtime: also adding a canary that 1) enforces session_kv_cap, 2) emits early alerts if per-session KV > 200k tokens.

elaine-support: sending interim customer comms now. cc: @sasha-oncall for approval.

sasha-oncall: approved. message: "We've applied emergency mitigations to address a memory surge affecting some hosted inference requests. We reverted the recent batching change and disabled prefetching. We're monitoring and will share a detailed RCA."

elaine-support: sent to affected accounts via support portal and email: acct-redwood-42, acct-borealis-7, acct-zen-ops.

incident-bot: ACTION: create incident ticket INC-2026-4898765432 and assign to eng-runtime.

tanvi-sre: adding retrospective notes: consider rollout guard for batching-window increases + QA harness covering long prompt/prefix scenarios.

jason-eng: quick config snippet for rollback we used:```bash
# rollback batching window
redwoodctl set config hosted --key=batching.max_window_ms --value=20 --scope=hosted-eu-2
# disable prefetch
redwoodctl set config hosted --key=kv.prefetch.enabled --value=false --scope=hosted-eu-2
# emergency session cap
redwoodctl set config hosted --key=session.kv_cap_tokens --value=256000 --scope=hosted-eu-2
```

sasha-oncall: postmortem owner: @jason-eng. deadline for initial draft: 48h. follow-up action owners: mike-runtime (canary/alerts), tanvi-sre (observability), elaine-support (customer comms).

mike-runtime: confirm moving rollback to global pause for v2 batching. scheduling roll back for other regions starting 03:10 UTC.

elaine-support: closing customer-facing note thread after follow-up ack from accounts.

sasha-oncall: closing pager handoff at 02:40 UTC — moving to post-incident channel for RCA drafting. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, incident state -> recovered, severity -> sev2.

jason-eng: final: we'll keep prefetch disabled by default until compaction fix rolls out and add a safety cap on session kv size. will post status updates in #eng-runtime and link PRs in the postmortem.

elaine-support: thanks team. will coordinate any required billing or credit make-good conversations after RCA.

sasha-oncall: nice work — quick mitigation and clear comms.
